text:
Sam Lincoln: quick flag — CedarTech, NimbusHealth, and BlueRoot pilots all stalled on the invite/SSO step. Customers reporting 'invalid SAML mapping'. risk: renewal conversations next Thurs if not live.
Priya Rao: ugh. Which envs? staging or prod?
Sam Lincoln: staging first, tried repro in prod and saw same map mismatch. shared logs with eng.
Mateo Cruz: on it. I saw similar errors yesterday from another tenant — likely the attribute-map change we rolled.
Jen Kim: cc @Priya — I've got enablement slots this week for CedarTech, need ETA to reschedule or send a workaround email.
Aaron Holt: can you paste the exact error? I can push a targeted rollback if needed.
Sam Lincoln: error snippet from customer: `SAMLResponse: attribute 'email' not found -> mapping failure`
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421-87 assigned to eng-runtime. Link: https://redwood.example.com/incidents/INC-2026-0421-87
Mateo Cruz: confirm root cause — new attribute default changed from `mail` -> `emailAddress` during last deploy. I can hotfix mapping to accept both. Est ~45m to deploy fix to staging, 2h for prod rollout with canary.
Lina Vo: I'll message CedarTech contact with an interim workaround: ask ID team to alias `email` to `mail` in their assertion, and offer a scheduled retest. Draft below — feel free to edit:
```
Hi Sam & team — quick update: our engineers identified a mapping mismatch. If your IDP can send `mail` in the SAML assertion as an alias for email we can proceed immediately. Otherwise we'll rerun a fix by EOD and schedule a short retest. Will keep you posted. — Lina
```
Jen Kim: thanks Lina. If fix slides past my enablement slot I can do a short pre-recorded walkthrough and then live QA after fix.
Priya Rao: ask sales to pause renewal flagging for these accounts for 72h? who owns that?
Aaron Holt: @Priya I can put a hold in Gainsight, note: "pending SSO mapping fix". Will do now.
Sam Lincoln: can eng post the playbook link after rollout? I'll add to customer updates.
Mateo Cruz: playbook: https://redwood.example.com/playbooks/onboard-sso-mapping — I'll update the troubleshooting section with the new acceptance of `mail`/`emailAddress` after deploy.
Sam Lincoln: awesome. timeline summary for Cheryl (CedarTech): staging fix in ~45m, prod canary + rollout in ~2h, ETA fully verified 3h. Lina will send interim note. Jen will record walkthrough if needed. Aaron put hold in Gainsight.
Lina Vo: sending note to CedarTech now. pinging NimbusHealth & BlueRoot to let them know same root cause.
ops-bot: INC-2026-0421-87 status -> in_progress (updated by Mateo Cruz)
Priya Rao: perfect — I'll loop in CSM lead for renewal sync tomorrow morning. thanks team :raised_hands:
